description: Recent SEC filings of a company, optionally by form type. Newest filings first: form, filing date, report period, description, 8-K item codes and a direct link to the document. Filter with form=10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 4, 13F-HR, S-1, DEF 14A and others. Price $0.010 per call (x402: USDC on Base or Solana).

form.description: SEC form type to keep, exact match (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 4, S-1...). Empty = all forms
